title: Sugarloaf Harbour Marina
specs: Must comply with City of Port Colborne short-term rental licensing by-law 7388/79/25
Must have working smoke and CO alarms, fire extinguishers, and a posted fire safety plan
Local contact person must be available 24/7 to respond quickly to complaints or emergencies
Occupancy limited by number of licensed bedrooms with strict renter and guest caps
Adequate on-site parking required; street parking not permitted
Liability insurance of at least $2 million required
gap: No details on guest capacity or bedroom count for Sugarloaf Harbour Marina
blurb: Sugarloaf Harbour Marina is listed as a licensed short-term rental accommodation in Port Colborne under license number LIC-2026-0303. It is subject to the City of Port Colborne's short-term rental licensing by-law 7388/79/25 effective November 1, 2025. The by-law requires operators to have a license, maintain safety equipment, provide local contact availability, and comply with occupancy and parking regulations.
extraNote: Annual license required to operate or advertise short-term rental · Renewal fee $480 + HST for existing operators in Vacation Residential Zone · Renewal fee $600 + HST for existing operators outside Vacation Residential Zone · Initial application fee $800 + HST for trailers, mobile homes, park model homes in Vacation Residential Zone · Initial application fee $1,000 + HST for all other dwelling units · Late applications subject to 25% late fee and conditional license
